title: Finch West Line 6 Benefitting From Signal, Operational Adjustments
summary: Three quarters of a year since opening to passengers in December 2025, the Finch West Line 6 LRT is benefiting from a new series of signal and operational adjustments designed to boost speed along the heavily scrutinized line. Running 10.3 kilometres from Line 1’s Finch West station to Humber College's North Campus at Highway 27, the surface route has delivered long-awaited rail connections to a broad swath of North York and Etobicoke.
